---
title: "Feature: Installable offline Progressive Web App"
labels: "enhancement,roadmap,priority:P2,area:platform"
---

## Goal

Make DeployVault installable from a browser while preserving the existing
portable and desktop-launcher options.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a web app manifest with project icons and standalone display mode.
- Add a service worker that precaches versioned application assets.
- Keep drill data and the application usable offline after first load.
- Display an update notification when a new cache version is ready.
- Never cache or intercept unrelated origins.
- Provide a clear cache-reset recovery path.
- Test installation and offline startup in Chromium.
- Document limits on iOS and non-Chromium browsers.

## Security considerations

Use an explicit asset allowlist and versioned cache names. The service worker
must not expand DeployVault's default network exposure.
